title: Session 1 — Participant 6 User + Claude Behavior Graphs
goal: RESEARCH, ORGANIZE, AND DRAFT A WELL-SUPPORTED SUB-SECTION OF A MEMORANDUM ON THE ATTORNEY-CLIENT PRIVILEGE IN GEORGIA ADDRESSING THE GOVERNING STATUTE, THE 2013 RECODIFICATION AND PREDECESSOR STATUTES, AND THE PRIVILEGE'S COMMON-LAW ORIGINS

Step 1.step_name: Define the assignment, scope, and research questions
Step 1.step_action: Provide Claude with the jurisdiction and the issues the memorandum section needed to address; divide the work among the current Georgia statute, related confidentiality duties, the pre-2013 statutory scheme, and the privilege's common-law development.

nodes.label: Scoping the corporate-privilege doctrine
nodes.detail: Opens with a question on the major Georgia corporate attorney-client privilege cases, to gauge the landscape before defining the memo

nodes.label: Mapping the statutory frame and controlling case law
nodes.detail: Synthesizes Georgia's evidentiary-privilege statute and the foundational corporate cases (Marriott, Zielinski, St. Simons, Ledbetter, waiver and crime-fraud lines)

nodes.label: Filtering Lexis+ research to Georgia jurisdiction
nodes.detail: Opens Lexis+ and applies a Georgia jurisdiction filter to narrow the legal research to Georgia authorities

nodes.label: Deepening understanding of the corporate-privilege tests
nodes.detail: Reviews the case landscape, then asks Claude to unpack the control-group versus subject-matter tests

nodes.label: Asking Claude to describe the control-group and subject-matter tests
nodes.detail: Writes a prompt

nodes.label: Explaining the doctrinal split and Georgia's hybrid approach
nodes.detail: Control-group test, subject-matter test, Upjohn's rejection of the control group, and why Georgia's Marriott test blends both

nodes.label: Reviewing the doctrinal explanation
nodes.detail: Reviews the doctrinal split and Georgia's hybrid approach explanation

nodes.label: Requesting a structured outline for the privilege memo sub-section
nodes.detail: Writes a prompt

nodes.label: Proposing a research plan and outline
nodes.detail: Delivers a ten-part outline (source/structure, elements, scope, entity clients, waiver, exceptions, work product, procedure, open questions) with authority slotted under each heading

nodes.label: Reviewing a cited case in Lexis+
nodes.detail: Reads the case identified in Claude's preceding research response while Claude continues running

nodes.label: Selecting which piece of the plan to execute first
nodes.detail: Reviews the outline and decides to focus the session on 'II. Source and Structure of the Privilege'

Step 2.step_name: Research and analyze the governing Georgia statute
Step 2.step_action: Identify and synthesize O.C.G.A. § 24-5-501(a)(2), its legislative history, its operation in discovery, and the related duties under O.C.G.A. § 15-19-4 and Georgia Rule of Professional Conduct 1.6.

nodes.label: Committing to drafting the governing-statute sub-section
nodes.detail: Narrows scope to 'II. Source and Structure' and requests a full draft of that sub-section

nodes.label: Drafting the statutory foundation of the privilege section
nodes.detail: Produces the sub-section centered on O.C.G.A. § 24-5-501(a)(2)'s silences, with preliminary predecessor-statute and common-law content seeded in

nodes.label: Setting up the subsection format in Word
nodes.detail: Opens Microsoft Word, adds the subsection title, and establishes the formatting for the draft

nodes.label: Reviewing another cited case in Lexis+
nodes.detail: Reads another case identified in Claude's preceding research response while Claude continues drafting

nodes.label: Assessing the draft's substance and gaps
nodes.detail: Reads the delivered draft closely before deciding what to refine next, cross-checking cited case law directly on Lexis+

nodes.label: Teaching Claude their own writing voice
nodes.detail: Submits a self-edited paragraph as a style sample and asks Claude to identify the changes and apply them

nodes.label: Reverse-engineering and applying the attorney's prose style
nodes.detail: Diagnoses the stylistic pattern (em-dashes removed, citations set off, evaluative asides kept) and rewrites the whole draft to match, including sharpening the common-law Fleming discussion in Part C

nodes.label: Checking whether the restyled draft still reads as their own
nodes.detail: Reviews the rewritten draft against their intended voice

nodes.label: Asking Claude to pull the text of the rule
nodes.detail: Writes a prompt

nodes.label: Pinning down the exact boundary between privilege and confidentiality
nodes.detail: Retrieves and delivers the verified current text of Ga. R. Prof. Conduct 1.6, distinguishing the ethical duty from the evidentiary privilege

nodes.label: Weighing how the ethics-rule text sharpens the statutory analysis
nodes.detail: Reviews Rule 1.6 and its relationship to the governing statute before moving on

Step 3.step_name: Trace the predecessor statutes and assess the 2013 recodification
Step 3.step_action: Compare former O.C.G.A. §§ 24-9-21(2), 24-9-24, 24-9-25, and 24-9-27(c) with current § 24-5-501(a)(2); analyze St. Simons Waterfront, State v. Ledbetter, and Volkova; avoid overstating the survival of pre-2013 doctrine.

nodes.label: Asking Claude to provide the text of the former statutes
nodes.detail: Writes a prompt

nodes.label: Retrieving verified predecessor-statute text
nodes.detail: Pulls the archived text of former O.C.G.A. §§ 24-9-24 and 24-9-25 and flags where their paraphrase needs correction

nodes.label: Refining statutory text and checking the cited authority
nodes.detail: Copies text from Claude into Word, refines it, and searches the cited case in Lexis+

nodes.label: Incorporating verified history and preparing for a full editorial pass
nodes.detail: Reviews and incorporates the former-statute text into the draft, then assembles the combined document for review

Step 5.step_name: Integrate, revise, and verify the final memorandum section
Step 5.step_action: Combine the drafted components, revise for accuracy, flow, tone, and citation form, and use Claude to identify gaps, overstatements, and awkward transitions.

nodes.label: Submitting the integrated draft for a comprehensive quality check
nodes.detail: Uploads the combined Word document and asks Claude to proofread it and list suggested revisions

nodes.label: Auditing the full draft for errors, gaps, and structural weaknesses
nodes.detail: Catalogs typos, an incomplete statutory description, an unverified citation, wording problems, a structural gap in Part B, and formatting inconsistencies across Parts A–D

nodes.label: Triaging which flagged issues to act on first
nodes.detail: Reviews the findings list and begins working through them in priority order

nodes.label: Closing the first flagged gap: an incomplete predecessor-statute description
nodes.detail: Asks for a complete, pasteable description of former § 24-9-24 that fixes the omission proofreading caught

nodes.label: Supplying a corrected, ready-to-use replacement
nodes.detail: Delivers two versions of the complete § 24-9-24 description, with a caution about unverified downstream citations

nodes.label: Incorporating the generated revision
nodes.detail: Incorporates the response from Claude to the draft

nodes.label: Chasing down the second flagged gap: an unverified citation
nodes.detail: Asks Claude to verify the still-open Ledbetter pincite

nodes.label: Discovering the citation error runs deeper than a page number
nodes.detail: Finds the underlying proposition itself was stated backwards, recommends deleting the paragraph built on it, and confirms Ledbetter's and Volkova's actual treatment of the recodification

nodes.label: Revising the draft to address Claude's flagged errors
nodes.detail: Revises the draft in Microsoft Word based on the errors and issues identified by Claude

nodes.label: Rebuilding the argument on corrected ground
nodes.detail: Reviews the correction, then asks for a clean rewrite of Part B restoring the recodification's stakes

nodes.label: Delivering the corrected, argument-restored predecessor-statutes section
nodes.detail: Rewrites Part B to account for a fourth predecessor statute, the competency-statute exposure, and the restored stakes paragraph

nodes.label: Closing the loop and completing the final review
nodes.detail: Incorporates the supported revisions into Word, runs Lexis Plus Brief Check on the cited authorities and statutory language, and completes final attorney review of the finished seven-page section
